_spec: Phase 1 marketing imagery. Every prompt must produce documentary contractor photography — natural, believable, not AI-polished. Team: black tees, circular seal on upper back, faces never visible. Before/after pairs share identical cameraLock text. NOTE (gallery befores regen): all 20 gallery '*-before' images were regenerated by feeding the matching '*-after' PNG as a reference image so structure, layout and camera position stay locked, then generating the dated/unfinished/pre-construction state of that exact space. Sources were generated at 4:3 landscape and cover-cropped centre to 1536x1024 (matching the afters) before encoding PNG + WebP q80.
styleSuffix: Documentary contractor project photography in a Treasure Valley Idaho home, natural available window light, slight sensor grain, imperfect real-world details, warm muted color grading, 35mm lens perspective, looks like an iPhone or DSLR photo from a real jobsite walkthrough. Not CGI, not a 3D render, not stock photography, not overly staged or artificially perfect. No visible faces on any people. Team members shown from behind wearing plain black t-shirts with the exact Boise Remodeling Co circular seal printed on the upper back: double-ring circle, CUSTOM REMODELING arched above, BOISE with horizontal rules, Remodeling in elegant serif script center, CO below, EST 2020 arched at bottom — use the provided reference seal artwork exactly. No other logos or readable text.
